call_points.text: May need another manufacturing unit in India; looking at targets but nothing concrete.
US order book strong; Q2 revenue expected better than Q1 and Q3 the strongest.
Q1 gross margin benefited from favourable product mix, low-cost inventory and forex.
Cash will be kept for acquisitions, not invested in market instruments; more European deals being explored.
No timeline for the next USFDA inspection; one plant was audited less than 12 months ago.
US tariff talk treated as wait-and-watch; management said it would not put much weight on it.

operating_notes.text: UK and Europe Q1FY27 revenue was ₹356 Cr, up 74.7% YoY; excluding QliniQ's ₹44 Cr, the region grew 53.1%.
About 65-70% of sales are manufactured in India; the UK mix is about 55% Rx and 45% OTC, while Europe is expected at 80-85% Rx.
Goa Teva facility is at ₹50-plus Cr revenue against a projected ₹80 Cr, about 60-65% of the target.
